title: Plan Servicing Console Reference: Add-On Charges on an Active Patient Payment Plans Plan
content:
Where the tier permits add-ons, an active plan under the Patient Payment Plans carries every eligible charge of the encounters enrolled on it: a charge the financial account posts for an encounter the plan enrolled at its proposal, and not yet on the plan, is added to it as an add-on, one charge per entry.

## Scope

| Situation on the records | Result |
|---|---|
| Active plan on a tier that permits add-ons; the Patient Financial Account shows a charge posted to an encounter the plan enrolled at its proposal; the plan has no enrollment entry for that charge | The charge is added to the plan as an add-on enrollment entry |
| A charge the plan already carries | Not added again under this rule |
| A tier that permits no add-ons | No add-on under this rule |

Each add-on enrollment entry carries one charge.

## Console action: `enroll_add_on_charge_102110ed`

**Capability.** Adds one financial-account charge to a signed, active payment plan as an add-on entry of that plan. One call adds one plan ledger entry of the kind "balance enrolled" with the enrollment reason `add_on`, dated today and pointing at the charge, and raises the plan's remaining balance by the amount given. The charge itself on the financial account is not changed, and the plan's installment and term are not changed by this call.

**Invocation.** This is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `enroll_add_on_charge_102110ed`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payment_plan_id` | Reference number of the active payment plan receiving the add-on, as shown by the payment plan lookup for the patient | Identifier |
| `billing_txn_id` | Reference number of the financial-account charge being added, as shown by the financial account ledger lookup | Identifier |
| `amount` | The amount of the charge added to the plan | USD, 2 decimal places, positive; stored exactly as given, rounded half up to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new plan ledger entry reference (text beginning "ppt_"), the charge reference, the payment plan reference, the amount added in USD with 2 decimal places and the plan's remaining balance including the add-on in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving this sentence means the add-on is booked; afterwards a lookup of the plan ledger by the charge reference shows the add-on, and the plan's remaining balance includes it.
